_comment: Copy this file to config.json and edit. Never commit config.json — it may contain a token.
_token_comment: Set a shared secret to authenticate the game host. Leave empty to allow unauthenticated access (fine on a trusted LAN).
_track_comment: If true, camera gaze starts when the agent boots. Even when false, POST /init from the game host starts tracking for a Reachy-enabled session.
_audio_comment: Absolute path to the audio/ folder on the robot.
_robot_timeout_comment: Seconds to wait for the daemon WebRTC media connection.
_volume_comment: Speaker output 0-100. Applied when the agent starts.
